raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: The Planner switched to an arbitrary “blue-linked only” counting rule, inconsistently included touring members for Screaming Trees while omitting official members of Letters to Cleo, and produced incorrect member lists. Specifically, they excluded core Letters to Cleo members (e.g., Greg McKenna, Joe Klompus, and several past members) and added Screaming Trees touring names (e.g., Dan Peters, Donna Dresch) as if they were official members. This contradicted earlier gathered data (Letters to Cleo had ~14 distinct members) and led to the wrong conclusion that Screaming Trees had more members, followed by premature task completion without reconciling discrepancies.
